paper.authors: Sami Yamani Douzi Sorkhabi and David A. Romero and J. Christopher Beck and Cristina H. Amon
paper.title: Constrained Multi-Objective Wind Farm Layout Optimization: Novel Constraint Handling Approach Based on Constraint Programming

paper_source_conflicts: Printed Jensen Eqs. 1, 3, and 4 mix induction-factor conventions; the standard full deficit 1-sqrt(1-CT) controls.
Printed CP Eq. 20 compares repaired turbines against starred current coordinates even when several turbines are repaired; the reconstruction enforces pairwise spacing among all repaired variables.
Printed Eq. 17 adds a positive penalty to an AEP objective described as maximized; the implementation minimizes negative AEP plus penalty.

The maximum-distance unit is not restated after discretization; squared 150-bin coordinates are required for the paper's reported repair percentages, while an m2 interpretation makes MD=50/100 effectively unusable.
missing_information: author C++ NSGA-II and IBM CP interface source
nine native random polygon maps and receptor arrays
target-paper penalty coefficients and NSGA-II distribution indices
author random states and raw Pareto fronts
complete ISO atmospheric, ground, and receptor constants
completion_decisions: Use deterministic similar-area jittered-Voronoi maps and one receptor per forbidden seed.
Reconstruct the 24 by 43 wind matrix from the cited Kusiak direction probabilities and Weibull scales.
Use standard full Jensen deficit, root-sum-square superposition, and the paper turbine curve.
Use the predecessor's 1e4/4e4 penalties and 1.5 m receptor height, Deb-standard eta_c=eta_m=20, and declared PyWake-cross-checked ISO constants.
Interpret maximum distance in squared discrete-bin coordinates.

Replace proprietary CP with a fully declared feasibility-first open joint repair retaining 150 bins, ten-second upper bound, nearest-candidate cap, fixed search-node bound, and complete truncation telemetry.
Parallelize every safe repair, evaluator, offspring, dominance, and independent-run region while keeping ordered NSGA-II state semantics.
Execute only the paper target CHCP-NSGA-II method; the dynamic-penalty-only comparator is not a target asset.

decision_variables.resolution: 2N continuous turbine coordinates in a 3 km by 3 km square

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: continuous NSGA-II coordinates; only CHCP repair discretizes each coordinate to 150 bins

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize AEP and minimize maximum expected receptor SPL, implemented as minimize negative AEP and SPL with positive dynamic penalties

constraints_and_repair.resolution: minimum spacing 5D and no turbine in forbidden polygons; infeasible layouts enter bounded joint 150-bin CHCP repair before dynamic-penalty fallback

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen top-hat wake, full deficit 1-sqrt(1-CT), RSS deficits, paper linear/rated 1.5MW power curve, and ISO 9613 expected SPL

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 24 direction bins, 43 speeds from 4 to 25 m/s in 0.5 m/s increments, direction-conditioned truncated Weibull reconstruction

initialization.resolution: uniform continuous layouts using counter-keyed random events; native author seeds unavailable

update_order.resolution: tournament, SBX, polynomial mutation, CHCP-or-penalty evaluation, dominance/crowding environmental selection, ordered generation commit

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: at most 80000 complete layout evaluations or last-100 rank-one crowding variance below 0.005; each complete AEP/SPL/constraint evaluation is one physical FES

parameters.resolution: population 200/150/100 for land availability 70/80/90, crossover 0.95, mutation 0.05, eta_c=eta_m=20, penalties 1e4/4e4, CP MD=50/100/1000/10000 bin2

paper_native_cases.resolution: nine switchable reconstructed maps: land availability 70/80/90 percent crossed with 5/10/15 turbines

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: 40 runs per case and maximum distance from 20 seeds and two penalties; Pareto fronts, CP percentage, convergence, physical FES, repair/evaluator/algorithm/end-to-end timings, worker receipts, and science hashes

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation and declared-map academic flexible reproduction of CHCP-NSGA-II and all nine native problem definitions; not author code, IBM CP behavior, native maps, native random states, or exact numerical replay
